subject: GlimmerTech discovery → pilot kickoff decisions & access requests
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@glimmertech.com>, Priyanka Rao <priyanka@glimmertech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: GlimmerTech discovery — confirmed pains, proposed pilot scope, next steps

Hi Sam / Priyanka — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we draft the pilot SOW:

Key pains you confirmed:
- High false positive rate on intent classification in your chat routing (currently ~18–22%).
- Unpredictable token cost spikes during peak business hours when legacy batching fails.
- Need to preserve customer PII in telemetry — SOC2/compliance gate.

Primary goals for a 6-week pilot (what success looks like):
1) Reduce intent FP to <= 12% on the baseline prompt set for support intents.
2) Achieve median generation latency < 120ms at 95th percentile for 1k rps traffic simulation (internal perf target).
3) Establish safe data handling: confirm that telemetry can be routed to your S3 bucket with PII redaction and auditing.

Proposed pilot scope (high level):
- Duration: 6 weeks (1 week setup, 4 weeks evaluation, 1 week wrap & handoff).
- Models: Redwood-curated Llama-3-small quantized variant for inference + fallback to a cheaper variant for low-latency routing.
- Workstreams: access & infra, prompt set & evals, traffic replay & telemetry, quality/regression gating.

Immediate asks of GlimmerTech (access/setup):
- Provide an AWS IAM role ARN or short-term credentials for a read-only S3 bucket with sample telemetry (S3 path + sample files).
- Allowlist three outbound IPs for our test runners (I will include IPs in a follow-up).
- Point of contact for security questionnaire and SOC2 artifacts (we discussed Priyanka as primary).

Owners at Redwood:
- Marissa Cole: prompt set creation, evals, quality gating.
- Ben Carter: infra & observability config, perf runs, cost modeling.
- Me (Karthik): commercial coordination, SOW & timelines.

Attachments: I’ll attach a short access checklist and a draft SOW for review (first pass).

Next steps (proposed timeline):
- Today: I’ll send the access checklist + draft SOW (attached).
- Thu 17 Dec: you share S3 path + contact for SOC2 docs.
- Mon 21 Dec: kick off infra provisioning; Redwood teams start prompt/eval prep.
- 06 Jan: end of evaluation window and final readout.

If that looks right, Sam/Priyanka — can you confirm the S3 path and Priyanka as our security contact? Also flag any adjustments on the success metrics.

Thanks,
Karthik
--

Subject: Re: GlimmerTech discovery — confirmed pains, proposed pilot scope, next steps

Karthik — this is great, thanks for the clear recap. Confirmations and a small tweak below:

Confirmations:
- Priyanka is the security contact and will lead SOC2 docs / evidence requests.
- We will provide an S3 bucket with a sample week of telemetry (anonymized) — path and IAM role by Thu 17 Dec.
- We agree to the 6-week cadence and the three success metrics you listed.

Tweak:
- For latency target: our internal SLA target for surfaced actions is 100ms p95. We can accept 120ms for the pilot if you call out a plan to get to 100ms post-pilot. Please add a 30-day optimization window in the SOW for that follow-up work.

Also — curious about how you’ll handle prompt drift during replayed traffic. Can Marissa share a short note on the evals/prompt set strategy?

I’ll ask our infra team to prioritize the allowlist once you send IPs.

Thanks,
Sam

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 18:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GlimmerTech discovery — confirmed pains, proposed pilot scope, next steps

Thanks Sam — quick note on prompts/evals and drift handling so you have visibility: 

Eval & prompt strategy (summary):
- Prompt set: we’ll start with 600 labeled samples you provide (support intents + edge cases) and augment with 400 synthetic variants to stress paraphrase coverage.
- Drift detection: we’ll run daily lightweight drift checks comparing token distribution and top-K intent confusions. If drift exceeds the threshold (delta > 8% on top confusions), the system will flag for manual re-eval.
- Continual prompt tuning: during the 4-week evaluation window Marissa + your SME will iterate on ~2 prompt families per week; changes are tracked via a prompt versioning log.
- Success gating: FP reduction metric will be measured on a held-out replay dataset (not the training/label set). We’ll share a simple dashboard with rolling metrics.

On the latency target — happy to add a 30-day optimization clause for post-pilot work and include a short plan in the SOW outlining kernel/quantization steps we’ll prioritize.

I’ll start drafting the eval matrix and share the initial prompt families by Friday EOD. Ben — can you confirm the perf-run cadence (we recommended three runs: cold-start, steady-state, and peak replay) and whether the allowlist/IP format below works for infra?

Cheers,
Marissa
--

1) IP allowlist (we’ll provide exact IPs in separate email): 54.152.12.45, 54.152.12.46, 54.152.12.47
2) Pilot infra staging: we’ll spin up a 2-GPU dedicated pool (A100-equivalent) for the perf runs; cost estimate attached in SOW draft.
3) Telemetry ingestion: need an IAM role ARN from GlimmerTech with read permissions to the sample prefix. If they prefer credentials, we will accept short-term STS tokens.

Ben
